data.one_liner: A fully customizable Flutter widget to get count, applicable for e-commerce cart counts.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable widget with plus and minus buttons to increment and decrement numeric values (integers or doubles). It supports custom styles, themes, layout directions, and editing modes.
use_when: You need an e-commerce cart quantity stepper widget.
You want a customizable counter widget with increment and decrement buttons.
avoid_when: You need complex form validation or non-numeric inputs.
strengths: Supports both integer and double values.
Highly customizable styling and theming via CartStepperStyle.
Supports layout direction and custom icons.
